findings.body:
_🎯 Functional Correctness_ | _🟡 Minor_ | _⚡ Quick win_

**Move superseded container-audit Asks to the archive.**

The Ask reader scans every YAML file directly under `.arcadia/asks/`. It does not honor the `Supersedes` text in the v2 rationale. Both decision Asks can therefore create pending approvals with stale hashes.

_🎯 Functional Correctness_ | _🟡 Minor_ | _⚡ Quick win_

**Do not hard-code the operator's Docker socket path.**

Line 61 binds every audit to `unix:///Users/pmark/.docker/run/docker.sock`. Another host or another account has no socket at that path. On those hosts, `docker image inspect` fails, and a valid approved Grant is consumed with only an `audit.image` refusal. The previous review fixed the same hard-coded home directory in `containerAuditTransport.ts`, but this executor still has it. Derive the path from `os.homedir()`.

Because `executorHash` covers this file, the fix changes the executor hash. Regenerate the proof receipts after the change.

</details>
